content: Asmuṭṭi n Ttabut ɣar taddart n Ɛubid-Idum
Dawud imcawar ak-d imeqqranen x wařef d x mya u ak-d mkuř řḥakem.

Dawud inna i marra agraw n řgens n Israil: “Mařa yarḍa i kenniw uřa i SIDI, AREBBI nneɣ, ejj aneɣ ad nessekk deɣya ireqqasen ɣar aytmatneɣ nni iqqimen di marra timmura n Israil u ɣar ikehhanen d Ilawiyyen nni izeddɣen akidsen di tneddam ak-d ddmani nsent n tarewsa, ḥima nitni ad ɣarneɣ nnyarwen.
Uca ejj aneɣ ad ɣarneɣ dd-narr Ttabut n AREBBI, maɣar deg wussan n Cawul war kides neřhi.
Marra agraw n řgens inna belli ad ggen ammu, maɣar d man aya d ict n tmesřact d taṣebḥant di tiṭṭawin n marra řgens.
Dawud issmun marra Israil, zeg yeɣzar n Ciḥur ɣar Miṣra ař mani ɣa tiwḍed ɣar Ḥamat, ḥima ad ssgeɛɛden Ttabut n AREBBI zi Qaryat-Yaɛarim.
Xenni iffeɣ Dawud ak-d marra Israil ɣar Baɛla, ɣar Qaryat-Yaɛarim wenni iǧan di Yahuda ḥima ad ssgeɛɛden Ttabut n AREBBI ssenni. Ttabut n SIDI wenni ittɣiman jar ikiruben mani ittwařaɣa x Yisem nnes.
Nitni iwyen-dd Ttabut n AREBBI x ijj n ukarru n jdid zi taddart n Abinadab. Ɛuzza d Axiyu nedhen akarru.
Dawud d marra Israil ttiraren lmusiqa s marra jjehd nsen zzat i wudem n AREBBI s yezřan d řgambriyat d lharpat d ibendiren d teǧunin n wuzzař d řebwaq.
Umi dd-iwḍen nitni ɣar unedrar n Kidun, isswiẓẓeḍ Ɛuzza afus nnes, ḥima ad iṭṭef Ttabut minzi nderfen ifunasen.
Xas uca yarɣa weɣḍab n SIDI x Ɛuzza uca iwta i-t maɣar wanita isswiẓẓeḍ afus nnes ɣar Ttabut uca immut din zzat i wudem n AREBBI.
Yiweḍ ssem ɣar wuř n Dawud, aqa SIDI isɛar ammu x Ɛuzza u igga as i wemcan nni Fariṣ-Ɛuzza ař ass-a.
Deg wass nni teřqef Dawud tiggʷudi zi AREBBI, inna: “Mammec i ɣa ggeɣ ad ɣari dd-awyeɣ Ttabut n AREBBI?”
X uya Dawud war ijji ad ɣares dd-awyen Ttabut di tendint n Dawud, maca ijja i-tt ad taggʷej ɣar taddart n Ɛubid-Idum, Ajitti.
Tekka Ttabut n AREBBI třata n iyuren di taddart nnes ɣar aytbab n taddart n Ɛubid-Idum, u ibarek SIDI taddart n Ɛubid-Idum d marra min ɣares iǧan.
